passages.excerpt_preview: They concern themselves with all sects, ascetics and householders.
There is no gift like the gift of dhamma.

passages.locator: show respect to slaves and servants
passages.excerpt_preview: It is good to show respect to slaves and servants, obedience to mother and father, generosity to friends and relatives, and abstention from killing living beings.
My officers shall tour every five years for the instruction in dhamma and for other business.

passages.locator: prisoners be granted a respite of three days
passages.excerpt_preview: I have ordered that prisoners be granted a respite of three days.
My desire is that there should be uniformity in judicial procedure and punishment.
I have appointed officers of dhamma for the welfare and happiness of the people.
have ordered welfare measures, such as banyan trees to give shade, mango groves, wells at half-kos intervals and rest houses.
